name: Damping Mass
body:
School transmutation; Level cleric/oracle 5, sorcerer/wizard 4

Targets one creature/2 levels, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as damping except it affects multiple creatures.
